offering_description.value: KB Home builds and sells new single-family homes and townhomes to homebuyers, including first-time and repeat buyers. It develops residential communities and lets buyers select floor plans, finishes and other options. It also provides title and homeowners insurance agency services in select markets.

revenue_model.value: product sales: Purchases of newly built homes; service fees: Title services for home purchases; commissions or management fees: Placement of homeowners insurance policies
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Acquires land and coordinates trade contractors to build homes for individual buyers; service provider: Uses property and transaction records to provide title services to homebuyers; financial intermediary: Arranges coverage from insurance carriers for homebuyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US regional: Selected markets in the West, Southwest, Texas and Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: Single-family homes, townhomes, title services and homeowners insurance brokerage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales consultants who work with homebuyers; own locations: Community sales centers and model homes; agents / brokers: Independent real estate agents who represent homebuyers; online: Company website with home listings, virtual tours and sales inquiries
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Local zoning, building codes and permits, plus state licensing for title and insurance agency activities

notes: The exact markets served by its title and insurance operations are uncertain.
